claim_boundary: Three consecutive generations on one build on a contended box. The GPU/wall RATIO is the claim and it is stable to five decimal places across runs; the absolute TPS is DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE. This says nothing about what the 28 ms of GPU time is made of — only that it is GPU time.

corrects.consequence: The entire class in §11 — CPU submission, command buffers, readbacks, synchronization, state movement, host transforms, reporting, allocation, lock contention — is bounded at 0.9894 ms in TOTAL. Deleting all of it moves 34.4312 to 35.65 TPS, a gain of 1.214. Not the unlock. This lane should not be run.
corrects.measured_answer: host gap is 0.9894 ms, 3.4% of the token, reproducible to within 0.001 across three runs
corrects.premise: S019 §10: region timing explains ~9.67 ms of GPU work against ~28.2 ms wall, so ~18 ms may live outside measured GPU regions and hold the 71-TPS unlock
corrects.why_it_is_wrong: 9.67 ms was the UNEXPLAINED RESIDUAL in receipts/future/RESIDENT_TOKEN_BUDGET.json — the token minus bytes-at-clean-roof minus dispatch minus host gap. It was never the total GPU work. That receipt already recorded GPU at 27.64 ms of a 28.44 ms token, and ORGAN_BANDWIDTH covered 27.73 ms of a 27.83 ms GPU span across four organs.

note_on_protocol_overhead.what: client wall minus the resident's own reported wall, i.e. JSONL protocol and process boundary for a whole request
note_on_protocol_overhead.why_it_is_not_the_target: it is per REQUEST, not per token; at N=256 it is 0.026 ms/token and it does not scale with generation length

where_the_target_actually_is: Inside GPU time. ORGAN_BANDWIDTH shows MLP, DeltaNet and GQA all at ~350 GB/s against a 703.5 GB/s clean roof while the LM head reaches 497. The highest-EV experiment is S019 §7 — one representative MLP layer laid out for contiguous consumption in one or few fused regions with identical arithmetic. If it rises toward the LM-head regime, granularity is implicated; if it stays at 350, that hypothesis dies too and the next is representation decode cost.
